title: Brainrot Pet
description: A client-side Minecraft companion following your movement direction.
body:
# Brainrot Pet
---
## Key Features
* **Dynamic Movement Physics**: The pet is fully animated. When you walk, run, or strafe sideways/backward, the pet calculates its own movement direction and dynamically rotates its body to look exactly in the direction it is moving. When you stand still, it smoothly rotates back to face the same way you are looking.
* **Vanilla Lighting Integration**: Using native Minecraft rendering APIs, the pet is correctly lit depending on the light levels of the blocks and sky around it, blending perfectly into daylight, caves, or torchlit rooms.
* **ModMenu Configuration**: If you have ModMenu installed, you can access an in-game settings screen to customize your pet.
* **Toggle Keybinding**: You can easily show or hide your companion at any time. The default toggle key is **G**, which can be customized in the standard Minecraft controls settings under the "Brainrot Pet" category.
---
## Configuration Settings
You can adjust the following options in-game:
* **Follow Position**: Choose where your pet stands relative to you. You can set it to follow **Behind**, in **Front**, to your **Left**, or to your **Right**.
* **Visibility**: Toggle whether the pet is visible in the world or hidden.
---
